notes:
- **Pick a playback speed from a list.** The speed button in the player used to
  step through the speeds one click at a time — to get from 1× to 2× you had to
  click it four times. It now opens a small menu above the button with every
  speed in it (Normal, 1.25×, 1.5×, 1.75×, 2×) and a tick next to the one
  you're on, so you can jump straight to the one you want.
- **(Admin) A real delete button in Suggestions / Fixes.** The button that
  removes a message was too narrow for the X it was meant to show, so it came
  out as a faint dot. It's now a bin icon.
